ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure there are two vertical, mutually parallel long straight wires, and the current arrows in the left and right wires both point downward; the circular metal ring is located between the two wires, and the problem states that the metal ring approaches the straight wire on the right side. Then reason: according to the right-hand screw rule, the current in the left-side wire is downward, and the circular ring is on the right side of the left wire, so the magnetic field produced by the left wire at the circular ring is perpendicular to the paper surface outward; the current in the right-side wire is also downward, and the circular ring is on the left side of the right wire, so the magnetic field produced by the right wire at the circular ring is perpendicular to the paper surface inward. When the metal ring moves to the right, it is closer to the right wire, and the inward magnetic flux caused by the right wire increases; at the same time, it is farther from the left wire, and the outward magnetic flux caused by the left wire decreases. Therefore the change of the combined magnetic flux passing through the circular ring appears as an increase in inward magnetic flux. According to Lenz's law, the magnetic field produced by the induced current must hinder this change, so the induced magnetic field should be perpendicular to the paper surface outward. From the right-hand rule, when a magnetic field perpendicular to the paper surface outward is produced inside the circular ring, the direction of the induced current on the ring is counterclockwise.

method.method_draft: 先从图中确定圆环位于两根竖直平行导线之间，左、右导线中的电流箭头均向下；题干给出圆环向右侧直导线靠近。用右手螺旋定则判断两导线在圆环处产生的磁场方向：对左导线，圆环在其右侧，磁场垂直纸面向外；对右导线，圆环在其左侧，磁场垂直纸面向里。圆环向右运动时，右导线造成的向里磁通增大，同时左导线造成的向外磁通减小，所以穿过圆环的合磁通变化表现为“向里磁通增大”。根据楞次定律，感应电流产生的磁场要阻碍该变化，因此感应磁场应垂直纸面向外。再用右手定则判断环流方向：圆环中产生向外磁场时，电流方向为逆时针。
